rationale: A is more useful for a careful decision-maker because it distinguishes among live alternatives more sharply, includes explicit assumptions and scenario-dependent caveats, and provides quantitative forecasts with uncertainty ranges. That makes it easier to judge whether the recommendation holds in this team’s context. B gives stronger immediate implementation advice and a sensible hybrid recommendation, but it is lighter on uncertainty and offers almost no quantitative support, so it is less helpful for evaluating tradeoffs or pressure-testing the choice.
